card.name: MONAI BraTS brain tumour segmentation (SegResNet, 3D)
card.intendedUse: Research and education: segments the three nested BraTS glioma sub-regions (tumour core, whole tumour, enhancing tumour) on four co-registered, skull-stripped 3D brain MRI volumes (T1 post-contrast, T1, T2, FLAIR) and reports their volumes. It does not diagnose cancer.
card.validationStatus: Research model from the MONAI Model Zoo, evaluated by its authors on a held-out BraTS 2018 split; not clinically validated or cleared.
modality: Brain MRI: T1c, T1, T2, FLAIR (all four required)
imageTypes: DICOM series on the same voxel grid
limitations: Needs all four sequences co-registered to the same voxel grid, skull-stripped and at about 1 mm isotropic, as in BraTS. Raw scanner series give unreliable output
Trained on adult gliomas (BraTS 2018); metastases, paediatric and post-surgical brains are out of scope
The browser runs 128 mm windows; the bundle uses 240 × 240 × 160 windows, so borders between windows can differ slightly
card.confidenceMeaning: Mean sigmoid output inside each region. It is not a calibrated probability of cancer.
card.bundleDescription: A pre-trained model for volumetric (3D) segmentation of brain tumor subregions from multimodal MRIs based on BraTS 2018 data

input.name: image
input.voxelOrder: as stored in the file (no reorientation, as the bundle LoadImaged)

labelNotes.Tumor core: TC: enhancing tumour + necrotic and non-enhancing core

verification.reference: bundle network_def + models/model.pt in PyTorch; MONAI NormalizeIntensity + sliding_window_inference
